description: Search Apple's developer site the way developer.apple.com/search does, best match first: API reference, articles, sample code, the Human Interface Guidelines, App Store Connect Help and WWDC sessions. Use it to find pages by what they do or are about ("SwiftUI haptic feedback", "TestFlight external testers"); for a name you already know, search_docs_map answers at once. Returns links, each with its title, framework, kind and one-line summary; read a page with get_apple_doc_content, a session with get_wwdc_video. For sample code, type "sample" ranks every sample project on the site, including ones Apple's Sample Code Library doesn't list; for WWDC sessions, type "video". Searches run one at a time, 15 s apart, so several in a row are slow.

query.description: What you're looking for, in words or by name: "SwiftUI haptic feedback", "NSPredicate", "TestFlight external testers". Every word counts. A full list doesn't mean a match: when little fits, the list fills up with weaker results.

type.description: Leave out to search everything, as Apple's search page does with no filter; WWDC sessions show only where Apple mixes them in. "documentation": API reference and articles; "design": the Human Interface Guidelines; "sample": sample code projects; "help": App Store Connect Help (product page, review, TestFlight, pricing); "video": WWDC sessions alone.

name: search_apple_docs
title: Search Apple Docs
